name: sdrift-kombu-kombu-003-shared
instr:
# Reconcile implementation and docs in kombu

As maintainer of `kombu` (a messaging library with serialization, utility, rate-limit, and logical-clock APIs), you've noticed the code at `/app` and its documentation
disagree in a few spots (the prose under /app/docs/ and retained public docstrings under /app/kombu/). The documented contract is what callers rely on, so the code is
what's wrong. Make the implementation behave as documented.

Edit under `/app/kombu/` only, keep public interfaces and file structure intact, add nothing new, stay
offline. Evaluation compares your code to the documented behaviour on held-out inputs (documented serialization and pure utility calls).

Before editing, write a short plan to /app/APPROACH.md — what the docs specify, where the code diverges, and how you'll verify your fix — then implement it.
